❌ Exploit Kill-Chain & Three Physical-Chemical Disasters (Baseline ASR = 75.0%)

2. >160°C Al₄C₃ Free-Radical Pyrolysis Burst & +15.2°C Freeze-Plug Rupture

• 4 mol liquid cracks into 9 mol non-condensable CH₄ + catalytic Al⁰ -> >15 MPa burst!
• Freezes solid at +15.2°C; high-temp steam heating triggers >1.2 MPa/°C hydraulic burst
